[p1]
DATA SHEET
iES28GF-L2
Intelligent 28 Port Configurable Gigabit Ethernet
Switch IEC 61850, IEEE 1613, and EN50155 Certified
(9000 Series)
Product Overview
iES28GF-L2 is a highly redundant and scalable Layer 2 with Basic Routing functionality managed
Gigabit Ethernet switch with 4 fixed modules. It is designed to withstand the harshest environments of
transmission and distribution substations and rolling stock applications. The switch is IEC 61850 Ed.2,
IEEE 1613, and EN 50155 certified.
The iES28GF-L2 provides redundancy support through functions such as STP/RSTP/MSTP assuring
protection of all mission critical network applications. The iES28GF-L2 can be managed via the Web UI,
iManage Software Suite, Telnet, SSHv2, and Console (CLI). The switch provides advanced DOS/DDOS
auto prevention.
The iES28GF-L2 is made of IP-40 galvanized steel and has a wide operating temperature range from
-40°C to +85°C, which is suitable for the harshest of environments without use of fans.
